items.title: Backpack
items.description:
Organizing your gear will allow you to travel with readiness and order. On this book page you can see all your items and use them.

On this page you can see the amount of basic resources (food, magic, and coins) and the amount of items found. Some items are consumable, while other items you cannot be consumed.

exp.title: Training
exp.description: Experience earned along the adventure can be spent here, in a safe place, on the character's own qualities: every point bought raises Speed, Smart or Physique by one. The next point always costs more than the last, and each quality has a ceiling the story sets.

trained.description: Hours of drill in the quiet of a safe place have left their mark: what was learned on the road is now part of who you are. The experience is spent, the quality it bought stays with you for the rest of the journey.

registry.title: Registry
registry.description:
A page preserves the memory of your every step, recording the decisions that have marked your journey.

Turning these pages allows you to retrace the footprint left by your passage through the game world. On this page you can see the history of all important events and some relevant choices you made in the game that can influence the story and change the ending.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Paths Games ('we', 'us') collects and processes personal data when you use the game, and the rights you have under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA). Paths Games is designed to need as little personal data as possible: you can play anonymously as a guest, with no registration; signing in with a Google account is optional.
privacy.controllerBody: The data controller is Paths Games. We aim to comply with applicable EU and US data-protection law. For any privacy request or question, contact us at paths.games@proton.me.
privacy.dataBody: As a guest we do not ask for your name, email or payment details. We process an anonymous guest identifier (a random UUID and an auto-generated username), session and refresh tokens that keep you signed in (stored on our servers only as SHA-256 hashes), your in-game progress linked to that identifier, and — only if you consent — anonymous usage statistics via Google Analytics. If you sign in with Google we also process the account data described in section 2.1. Our hosting and content-delivery providers also process technical data such as your IP address and device or browser type transiently to deliver and secure the service.
privacy.accountBody: If you choose to sign in with Google, Google Identity Services gives us a signed token with your Google account identifier (the provider subject), your email address (only verified Gmail addresses are accepted), your name and surname, the address of your profile picture and your locale. Your account is identified by the email and the provider subject together. We use the email only to identify your account and for support: it is never used for commercial communications without your separate consent, and it is never written to our logs. Your nickname is created once from the part of the email before '@' and is shown in the game; name, surname, picture and locale are refreshed at every sign-in. Your profile picture is loaded directly from googleusercontent.com, so your browser sends your IP address to Google when the picture is shown. When you sign in, the matches of the guest session you were using on that device are linked to your account.
privacy.purposesTitle: 3. Why we process it and the legal basis
privacy.purposesBody: We process strictly necessary data to provide the game you request (performance of a contract and our legitimate interest in running the service), to keep it secure and prevent abuse (legitimate interest), and to measure usage through analytics (your consent, Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can withdraw analytics consent at any time.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use strictly necessary cookies and, with your consent, analytics cookies. Full details, including names and durations, are in our Cookies Policy, which you can reopen at any time via 'Cookie settings'.
privacy.sharingBody: We use Google (Google Analytics and Tag Manager) for optional analytics and Amazon Web Services / CloudFront for hosting and content delivery; they act as our processors. When you choose to sign in with Google, Google acts as the identity provider under its own privacy policy, and your profile picture is served by Google. We do not sell or 'share' your personal information as those terms are defined under the CCPA/CPRA, and we do not use it for cross-context behavioural advertising. When the game moves to a new stage, the administrator may export matches together with the account data of their players (email, names) to import them into the new stage: such export files are downloaded only by the administrator, deleted after the import and never published.
privacy.transfersBody: Some providers (such as Google) may process data outside the European Economic Area, including in the United States. Such transfers are protected by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or an equivalent safeguard.
privacy.retentionBody: Session cookies last up to 7 days (refresh token) and 30 days (guest identifier); your cookie choice is kept for 6 months; analytics data is retained for up to 2 years. An anonymous guest profile that has played at least one match is kept, so you can resume your adventures; a guest profile that never started a match is deleted after 60 days without access. A Google account is kept until you ask for its deletion or until 24 months pass without any access; then the account, its Google data (email, names, picture address, locale), its sessions, matches, characters and logs are deleted. Aggregated daily statistics contain no personal data and are kept. Our server logs are kept for 14 days, and the anti-abuse counters linked to your IP address are deleted automatically after a short time.
privacy.rightsBody: If you are in the EU/EEA you may access, rectify, erase, restrict or port your data, object to processing, and withdraw consent at any time, and you may lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. If you are a California resident you have the right to know, delete and correct your data and to opt out of sale or sharing (we do not sell or share), free from discrimination for exercising your rights. You can ask for the deletion of your Google account at paths.games@proton.me (an in-game option will come with the profile page); deletion removes all your data except the aggregated statistics. If an account is banned for breaking the Terms, we keep only a keyed hash (HMAC-SHA256 with a secret pepper) of its Google subject and of its email, so that the same person cannot open a new account; the hash cannot be turned back into your data. Because guest play is anonymous, we may be unable to identify a guest's data without additional information from you.
privacy.childrenBody: Paths Games is not directed to children under 14 in Italy or under 16 in the rest of the European Union, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from them; you must be at least that age to sign in with Google. If you believe a child has provided us data, contact us at paths.games@proton.me and we will delete it.
privacy.securityBody: We use measures such as HTTPS/TLS, HttpOnly session cookies and access controls to protect data. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and the game is currently in an alpha development phase.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this policy as the game evolves; material changes will be reflected by the 'last updated' date below, shown to signed-in users at their next sign-in and, where required, followed by a renewed consent request.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service ('Terms') govern your use of the Paths Games game and website. By accessing or playing Paths Games you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
terms.acceptanceBody: You must be at least 14 years old in Italy, or 16 in the rest of the European Union (or the age of digital consent of your country, if higher), to use Paths Games. By using the service you confirm that you meet this requirement and accept these Terms together with our Privacy Policy and Cookies Policy.
terms.serviceBody: Paths Games is a free-to-play gamebook video game with branching, multiplayer stories. It is currently in an alpha development phase and is provided 'as is' and 'as available'; features may change, break or be removed at any time.
terms.guestBody: Play is anonymous through an automatically created guest session; no registration is required. You are responsible for activity carried out through your session on your device. We may reset or revoke sessions to protect the service.
terms.accountBody: You may sign in with a Google account; only verified Gmail addresses are accepted. Your account is identified by its email and its Google identifier and cannot be moved to another email: a new email is a new account. We cannot restore an account whose Google account you have lost. When you sign in, the progress of the guest session you were using on that device is linked to your account. You may ask for the deletion of your account at any time; the deletion also removes your matches and cannot be undone. We may suspend or ban accounts that break these Terms.
terms.useBody: You agree not to misuse the service, including by cheating or manipulating game state, attempting unauthorised access, scraping or automated data collection, reverse-engineering beyond what the software licence permits, disrupting the service, or using it for any unlawful purpose.

terms.disclaimerBody: To the maximum extent permitted by law, the service is provided without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose and availability. As an alpha product it may contain bugs, lose progress or experience downtime.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookies Policy explains how Paths Games uses cookies and similar technologies in this game. A cookie is a small text file stored on your device. We group cookies into the categories below; you can accept or reject non-essential cookies at any time.
cookies.necessaryBody: These keep your session active and remember your cookie choice. They are essential, so they are always on and do not require consent: pathsgames.guestcookie (30 days), pathsgames.refreshToken (7 days) and pathsgames.cookiesConsent (6 months). The Google Identity Services script (accounts.google.com) is loaded only when you click 'Sign in with Google', as a strictly necessary part of the sign-in you ask for; Google may set its own cookies in the sign-in popup, under Google's cookie policy.
cookies.analyticsBody: With your consent we use Google Tag Manager / Google Analytics (_ga, _ga_*, up to 2 years) to measure usage anonymously and improve the game. Thanks to Google Consent Mode v2 these stay disabled until you accept, and no analytics cookie is written before then.
cookies.legalBody: We rely on the technical necessity of providing the service for strictly necessary cookies (exempt from consent under the ePrivacy Directive), and on your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) for analytics cookies.
cookies.manageBody: You can change or withdraw your consent at any time using the "Cookie settings" button below, with the same ease as giving it. You can also delete or block cookies through your browser settings, though strictly necessary cookies are required for the game to function.
cookies.thirdPartyBody: Analytics cookies are provided by Google. Google is also the provider of the optional sign-in, and your profile picture is loaded from googleusercontent.com (your browser sends your IP address to Google when it is shown). Google may process data outside the European Economic Area; such transfers are covered by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses. We do not sell your personal data.
cookies.rightsBody: Under the GDPR you may access, rectify or erase your data, object to or restrict processing, request portability, and withdraw consent at any time. You may also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. For requests, contact us at paths.games@proton.me.

policyBook.title: paths.games
policyBook.body: In a spirit of full transparency and appreciation of the digital ecosystem, paths.games stands as an open-architecture resource, firmly committed to collaborative innovation. This open-source vocation goes hand in hand with a rigorous safeguarding of personal data and unconditional compliance with the applicable legal framework. At the same time, the platform reaffirms its ethical commitment to the due protection of intellectual property and to the formal acknowledgement of the artistic and creative heritage of every single author.

roadmap.title: Devlog
roadmap.intro:
The paths.games is an open-source project, all code is available in a {repo}, the code is released under the GNU GPL v3 license.

All images, contents and stories are under a specific license, check the {credits}. Some stories are written by the Paths.games team and are covered by the {license} license.

Above all, it is a project made to have fun: playing, writing and building it together.

tips.location: This is where your character stands. Its events and the paths leaving it are on the right page.
tips.event: An event is something you can do here. It may cost energy or coins, and its effects change your character.
tips.action: An action is something you can do right now. Check its cost before you choose it.
tips.item: An item sits in your backpack. Use it to apply its effects, or drop it to free some weight.
tips.items: Your backpack: every item you carry, and how much it weighs against what you can carry.
tips.movement: A path to a nearby place. Moving costs energy, more when the weather is bad or the place is unsafe.
tips.class: Your class gives your character bonuses and decides some of the choices you can make.
tips.character: Your character: life, energy and the other statistics every choice reads and changes.
tips.trait: A trait changes your statistics for the whole match, for better or for worse.
tips.missions: Missions are goals the story sets. Complete their steps to earn the reward.
tips.missionStep: A step of the mission: complete it to move on to the next one. Only the next open step is shown, the ones after it stay hidden.
tips.registry: The registry remembers what happened in this match: keys written by places, events and choices.
tips.map: The map shows the places you have visited. Select one to read it; the unknown ones stay hidden.
tips.weather: The weather changes at every new time unit and changes the energy you spend to move.
tips.sleep: Sleeping ends the time unit: you recover energy and the world moves on while you rest.
tips.choice: A choice: pick one option, its consequences cannot be undone.
tips.experience: Experience earned in your adventures can be spent to raise a statistic.
tips.story: The story you are playing: its author, its world and its rules.
tips.difficulty: The difficulty sets how much energy, life and time you start with.
